snippet.title: #8 - Question Tagger (lhash) - Alibaba API + Hackathon
snippet.description:
Question Tagger is a multipurpose web app which one can use to tag and analyse his/her questions.

The key features of the web app are as follows:

Tag Questions - you can tag questions for your reference, so that you can practice questions of a particular tag later for improvement.

Analyse Tags - View all questions along with their submission status of the selected tag to gain insights of your ACs(accepted), WAs(wrong answer), TLEs(time limit exceeded), CTEs(compile time errors) and RTEs(run time error).

Test Generator - You can mark questions for improvement and can later create a practice test out of the questions available for improvement.

View Submission Status of Questions submitted during the mock test

Team Name : lhash

This app was coded as part of the Alibaba API + Hackathon organised by CodeChef in association with Alibaba.

Forum Link : https://alibabacloud.discuss.codechef.com/questions/136473/codechef-api-hackathon-submission-question-tagger

snippet.title: #8 Chef-CLI (dilbardilbar) - Alibaba API + Hackathon
snippet.description:
Description : Chef-Cli is a command line interface which uses CodeChef’s official API. This application is for those who hate graphical application and love to do everything from terminal. With features like sample submit and problem recommendation, It is designed to improve the overall productivity of the user.

Features :

View Problem Statement In Terminal
Get complete profile information about a particluar user. Get a graph of submissions made by the user in past one year. (Similar to submission graph of SPOJ)
Compare profiles of two users based on the ranking in various formats. Also get a comparison graph right on the terminal for better visualization
Submit a problem for evaluation against sample test cases and see if it passes or not.
Problem Recommendation recommends problem based on past solved problems by a user. Uses content based recommendation system for problem recommendation. Parameters -Difficulty , tags , No. of users who solved , Rating of user who solved
Get a ranking of all the institutes on CodeChef based on the performance of students in past contests.
Submit problems to CodeChef IDE directly from the terminal and get the final result right on the terminal.
Get list of both upcoming and currently running contests.
Get all details about a contest.
Get list of all the languages on codechef.
Get list of problems with a particular tag.
Search an institution from registered institution on Codechef.

Team Name: dilbardilbar

This app was coded as part of the Alibaba API + Hackathon organised by CodeChef in association with Alibaba.

Forum Link : https://alibabacloud.discuss.codechef.com/questions/136506/chef-cli-codechef-api-hackathon-submission

snippet.title: #3 Virtualizer (Heramb Patil and Jugal Rawlani) - Alibaba API + Hackathon
snippet.description:
Virtualizer allows users to run past Codechef contests in an environment that imitates a real competition. Features like real time Successful submissions help user to identify the difficulty of questions. Virtualizer also provides user with their overall global, country and organization rank and many more features.

We have also included an option to create Custom Contest which would consist of questions of various difficulty by analyzing the type of questions attempted by an user. We have currently included all the past LTIME and COOKOFF contest. We will be extending this feature to include past ICPC regional contests.

Team: Heramb Patil and Jugal Rawlani


This app was coded as part of the Alibaba API + Hackathon organised by CodeChef in association with Alibaba.

Forum Link : https://alibabacloud.discuss.codechef.com/questions/136844/codechef-virtual-contest

snippet.title: #2 Virtual Contest (hasan_356 & v_ns) - Alibaba API + Hackathon
snippet.description:
This app lets you play Codechef contests in a Virtual manner, those who have played virtual contests on Codeforces would be aware about it.

"Virtual Contests enable the users to run the past contests in a special mode that would imitate a real competition. It feels just like a real contest with real contestants competing alongside with the participant who plays a virtual contest.”

It will be very helpful for preparation of short contests. Few of the features are :

-You can add Friends and see their separate ranklist during live virtual contest.
-Several people can play virtual contest together and see each others ranking.
-All COOKOFF's starting from COOK01 to recent COOK98A/B are available to play as virtual contest.
-You can compare yourself with other people while virtual contest is in play.

snippet.title: There is nothing a Code can't do.
snippet.description:
An initiative by Directi, CodeChef for Schools aims to bring up a programming culture in high schools, to help school kids evolve as programmers. 

To know more about this initiative please visit: 
http://www.codechef.com/school
http://blog.codechef.com/2013/06/28/codechef-for-schools-lets-program-a-better-tomorrow/

Like us on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/CodeChefForSchools

The video depicts the story of the British mathematician and computer scientist, Alan Turing, who is also known as the father of computer science and artificial intelligence. Alan Turing is known for inventing the Turing machine, which is considered the basis of all modern computing devices. 

During World War II, he began to work secretly for the British cryptanalytic department. 

The Germans had invented the Enigma machine to encrypt the messages that they used to send to their other Axis forces. Because of the sensitive nature of these messages they were encrypted by this powerful machine so that no one can read them apart from their friends. Breaking these messages required mastering cryptanalysis and it was a lot advanced. 

But with his mathematical and computing genius, Alan Turing played a very important role in deciphering the messages encrypted by the Enigma machine. He designed a machine known as a bombe that successfully decoded the German messages. 

The successful decryption of these messages by the Allies of the German "Enigma" Cipher was the most important cryptographic event during the war. This provided vital intelligence for the Allies, which came to their aid during the war to great extent. 

With his computing ability Alan succeeded in doing what plethora of democrats and heavy artillery failed to do, which shows the power of writing great code. The computing world has grown a lot since Alan Turing, but still the individuals who can write beautiful code are the superheroes.

With the help of this video, we want to show what power programming has given us. There is nothing that a Code cannot do. 

You can help us in this initiative but becoming a volunteer for CodeChef For Schools here: http://www.codechef.com/school/volunteer. Or simply write to us at school@codechef.com

The video was created by the Lofundwala team that can be contacted here: www.facebook.com/lowfundwala
